# Shadowing a short recording

Listen to a short passage and speak along just behind the recording. This encourages attention to rhythm, linking and stress. Start with a passage whose meaning is already understood so that decoding the story does not consume all attention.

Record a brief attempt and compare one feature at a time. Fluent imitation does not necessarily demonstrate perception of a particular vowel contrast. Alternate shadowing with other activities rather than using speed as the only success measure. Rest the voice when the exercise becomes strained.
